@graph.description: Organize with Kanban. Work with native agent CLIs. Canban is a local-first, zero-telemetry, direct end-to-end encrypted native macOS and Linux Rust app (zero Electron) pairing local Kanban cards, a global Attention Inbox, isolated Git worktree diff review, optional local workflows, and Herdr persistent PTY terminals across local and remote Linux canband hosts.
featureList: Flexible Kanban board with Markdown specs, #Card links, screenshots, @Agent discussions, card agent assignees, isolated per-card Git worktrees, and GitHub Issue/PR sync
GitHub Actions-like YAML workflows & Visual Studio with shell scripts, agent + prompt steps, cron schedules, and serialized FIFO Queue Merge
Global Attention Inbox (⌘I) across all projects, terminals, and remote hosts with one-click jump to Card and live TTY
Native Agent CLI support in persistent Herdr PTY terminals (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity agy, Pi, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and 20+ CLIs) powered by Rust, longbridge/nsh, and libghostty-vt

Zero data collection, no relay servers, XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted local secret vaults, and direct Noise_XX end-to-end encrypted multi-host Linux canband connections with X25519 public-key auth, host key pinning, optional Tailscale WhoIs auto-auth & Tailnet discovery, SSH tunnels, and offline editing with 3-way sync
